name: Scattered Piece of Decarabian's Dream
description: The people did not bow to Decarabian out of respect or adoration, but because the harsh winds had laid them low. This was the shattered dream and ambition of the Anemo Archon<ref group="Note">The Chinese version of this item's description refers to Decarabian as a which is a term typically translated as "Anemo Archon" in the English translation. Because of this, the English version calls Decarabian an Anemo Archon even though he was never a member of The Seven. Barbatos, who ascended to godhood after Decarabian's fall, is the first and only Anemo Archon among The Seven.</ref> before the rise of Barbatos. He tried so hard to make his dream come true, and so the fragments of that dream are still mighty.
